name: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana (central subsidy)
summary: Central financial assistance for residential rooftop solar, paid to the homeowner's bank account after commissioning.

conditions: Apply through the national rooftop solar portal before installation.
Use a vendor registered on the portal.
Not already have a central solar subsidy for this connection.

verified_by: Aroha team (AI-assisted reading of the official EEREM Delhi page, last updated 13 Oct 2026); to be confirmed by a team member
notes: EEREM lists CFA as Rs 30,000 per kW up to 2 kW, Rs 18,000 for capacity above 2 kW up to 3 kW, and Rs 78,000 for 3 kW and above. Official portal: https://pmsuryaghar.gov.in

name: Delhi Solar Energy Policy 2023: state capital subsidy
summary: Delhi's capital subsidy for residential rooftop solar, passed through the first electricity bill after commissioning.

conditions: Share bank details with the DISCOM after the net meter is installed.

verified_by: Aroha team (AI-assisted reading of the official EEREM Delhi page, last updated 13 Oct 2026); to be confirmed by a team member
notes: Rs 2,000 per kW, up to Rs 10,000 per consumer, residential.

name: Delhi Solar Energy Policy 2023: generation-based incentive
summary: A monthly payment per unit generated, for 5 years, for residential systems commissioned while the policy is in force.

conditions: The system must be commissioned within the policy's three-year operative period.
Share bank details with the DISCOM after the net meter is installed.

verified_by: Aroha team (AI-assisted reading of the official EEREM Delhi pages, last updated 13 Oct 2026); to be confirmed by a team member
notes: Rs 3 per kWh up to 3 kW, Rs 2 per kWh above 3 kW up to 10 kW, monthly; valid for five years from commissioning if commissioned within the policy period (https://eerem.delhi.gov.in/hi/node/12632).

name: Delhi zero-upfront 3 kW rooftop scheme (reported, 2026)
summary: News reports describe a 2026 amendment offering up to 3 kW at no upfront cost to households using up to 400 units a month.

conditions: Not already have a solar subsidy under PM Surya Ghar or the Delhi scheme (as reported).

verified_by: Aroha team (AI-assisted); NOT found on the official EEREM page as of 1 Nov 2026
notes: Reported by news and installer sites only; amounts and terms conflict between reports. Excluded from all money figures until confirmed on an official Delhi government page.
